# A quiet gallery at lunchtime

The new gallery bench faces the exit rather than the large painting. A visitor said she could finally sit without feeling watched. I assumed seating was primarily about the view. Try moving one bench and observe whether people stay, while avoiding a claim about why any particular person sits down. [[Exhibition plan]] remains useful as a record of assumptions that can be revisited in another project.
